newsitem.title: USA: Network Event Theater to buy postcard ad co.
newsitem.headline: Network Event Theater to buy postcard ad co.

text.p: Network Event Theater Inc said Tuesday it will buy On The House, a postcard advertising company.
The parties are still negotiating the terms and closing date of the deal, the company said.

Combined with the recent purchase of PIK:NIK, another postcard advertising company, the acquisition of Chicago-based On The House will make Network Event Theater the largest provider of postcard advertising in three of the nation's top four media markets, the company said.
